notes.title: Castle Flipper - Premiere
notes.content:
Hi Folks!

I know you wait for some content from this game but our friends have a premiere of Castle Flipper. 

Along with it comes:


•	Stream that should start in few moments
•	Giveaway - for the best Medieval jokes we will be offering some Steam Keys of Castle Flipper
•	Great deal on launch with very nice price - just 18.99$ - 15%
•	Royalty bonus for those who own House Flipper or/and Train Station Renovation


•	Be quick! The offer lasts between May 26 – June 2

Get "Castle Flipper" here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/944250/Castle_Flipper

Watch the trailer:

[previewyoutube=Z4Rp17Tuiyg;full][/previewyoutube]


Go & make Medieval Times great again!

notes.title: Game Announcement and Question to Community
notes.content:
Hello, Celebrities!

Today we have announced our new game: Celebrity Life
It's a HUGE task. We are more then delighted to forge our idea and Your dreams to Code and Game!

Part of Gaming Factory Credo is to create a game altogether with its community so we would like to ask You a question:

"What kind of Celebrity would You like to become in our game?"

You can post Your answers here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1459990/discussions/0/2987537248821542207/
Or on our Discord Server.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39149589/34ca32c4fa77b7c22e3ca3fa6c486464fd95fe33.png

Our goal is to create a game that will be reviewable just as Dave Chappelle once said:
"I love being famous - it's phenomenal."

But for now, stay tuned for more awesome stuff on our Discord or Social Media!
https://linktr.ee/GamingFactorySA

Don't forget to Add Celebrity Life to Your Wishlist ;)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1459990/Celebrity_Life/
